document.abstract: This paper describes a Services-on-Demand (SoD) laboratory demonstrator with PC-based Set-Top-Boxes (STB). The implementation is part of a research project of Deutsche Telekom's Technology Centre. It aims at the verification and demonstration of the general concept to use the german public online service “T-Online” with internet access as a platform for SoD. Based on a first step configuration with two example applications, a first performance analysis has been made.
